LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Culture.label: kwazaari
LanguageData.BOR_Kwazaari_Culture.description: Kwazaari culture is defined less by shared belief than by shared practice. They call themselves humans, a word that in their usage carries a clear ceiling for everyone else. The past is not a resource they trade in.
LanguageData.BOR_Solarite_Culture.label: solarism
LanguageData.BOR_Solarite_Culture.description: Solarism holds that the original civilization was not destroyed but deferred — and that it falls to its heirs to finish what was started. In practice, this means a culture built around the idea that possessing solar-tier technology is itself a form of legitimacy. The republics that carry this doctrine vary widely, but most share the habit of not asking too hard where the inheritance actually came from.
